dataset.name: fashion_mnist
dataset.partition_status: paper states two class groups but does not publish their class IDs

claim_policy: This configuration implements the published network depths, normalization, optimizers, epoch count, sample counts, and repetition count. The unpublished image class partition, batch size, kernel-mean variant, and test-prior protocol keep it paper_protocol rather than a paper result.
known_gaps: The paper does not identify the MNIST/Fashion-MNIST class IDs assigned to its two groups; [0,1,2,3,4] is an explicit provisional choice.
The paper says mini-batch training but does not report batch size; 256 is an explicit implementation choice.
The paper does not fully specify image scaling/standardization; the runner scales pixels to [0,1] and the native representation standardizes each feature.
This execution config covers class prior 0.7; the other paper priors use separate locked configs and result directories.

The full canonical Fashion-MNIST test set is class-balanced (test positive rate 0.5); the configured prior controls the training unlabeled set because the paper does not publish a separate test-prior sampling rule.
The InfoMax paper says kernel-mean estimation but does not identify KM1 versus KM2; KM1 is an explicit provisional choice.
The validation split is materialized for provenance but is not used for early stopping because the paper reports fixed epoch counts.
